name: Calendar Event
description: One calendar event as an integration brought it in: title, when, where, who and how it repeats, the calendar it is on and where it came from. Re-imports update it; a cancelled event stays, marked cancelled.

global.schema:
type CalendarEventState {
  "The identity imports deduplicate on: cal:<account>:<UID>[:<recurrence-id>]"
  externalId: String
  "The iCalendar UID (Google: iCalUID)"
  uid: String
  "For a changed occurrence of a series: the original start it replaces"
  recurrenceId: String
  "The calendar the event is on"
  calendar: CalendarEventCalendar
  "Where it came from: google, microsoft, caldav"
  source: String
  "The provider's own id of the event"
  sourceId: String
  "The event on the provider's site"
  sourceUrl: String
  summary: String
  description: String
  location: String
  "A video meeting link (Meet, Zoom, Teams)"
  meetingUrl: String
  start: CalendarEventTime
  end: CalendarEventTime
  "A whole-day event: start and end are dates, the end exclusive"
  allDay: Boolean!
  status: CalendarEventStatus!
  "Busy or free in the person's availability"
  busy: Boolean!
  organizer: CalendarEventPerson
  attendees: [CalendarEventAttendee!]!
  "How a series repeats: its RRULE, EXDATE and RDATE lines"
  recurrence: [String!]!
  "When the provider last changed the event"
  sourceUpdatedAt: DateTime
  "When this document last took the provider's version"
  capturedAt: DateTime
}

type CalendarEventCalendar {
  "The provider's calendar id"
  id: String!
  name: String
  "The account the calendar belongs to, e.g. the Google address"
  account: String
}

type CalendarEventTime {
  "A moment, for an event with times"
  at: DateTime
  "A date (yyyy-mm-dd), for a whole-day event: the Date scalar takes a date-time"
  date: String
  "The zone the event was planned in, e.g. Europe/Brussels"
  timeZone: String
}

type CalendarEventPerson {
  email: String
  name: String
}

type CalendarEventAttendee {
  "The address in lower case"
  id: OID!
  email: String!
  name: String
  response: CalendarEventResponse!
  optional: Boolean!
  organizer: Boolean!
  "The account the calendar belongs to"
  self: Boolean!
}

enum CalendarEventStatus {
  CONFIRMED
  TENTATIVE
  CANCELLED
}

enum CalendarEventResponse {
  NEEDS_ACTION
  ACCEPTED
  DECLINED
  TENTATIVE
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "externalId": null,
  "uid": null,
  "recurrenceId": null,
  "calendar": null,
  "source": null,
  "sourceId": null,
  "sourceUrl": null,
  "summary": null,
  "description": null,
  "location": null,
  "meetingUrl": null,
  "start": null,
  "end": null,
  "allDay": false,
  "status": "CONFIRMED",
  "busy": true,
  "organizer": null,
  "attendees": [],
  "recurrence": [],
  "sourceUpdatedAt": null,
  "capturedAt": null
}

modules.name: capture
modules.description: Taking the provider's version of the event

operations.name: CAPTURE_EVENT
operations.schema:
input CalendarEventCalendarInput {
  id: String!
  name: String
  account: String
}

input CalendarEventTimeInput {
  at: DateTime
  date: String
  timeZone: String
}

input CalendarEventPersonInput {
  email: String
  name: String
}

input CalendarEventAttendeeInput {
  email: String!
  name: String
  response: CalendarEventResponse!
  optional: Boolean
  organizer: Boolean
  self: Boolean
}

input CaptureEventInput {
  externalId: String!
  uid: String
  recurrenceId: String
  calendar: CalendarEventCalendarInput
  source: String!
  sourceId: String
  sourceUrl: String
  summary: String
  description: String
  location: String
  meetingUrl: String
  start: CalendarEventTimeInput
  end: CalendarEventTimeInput
  allDay: Boolean!
  status: CalendarEventStatus!
  busy: Boolean
  organizer: CalendarEventPersonInput
  attendees: [CalendarEventAttendeeInput!]
  recurrence: [String!]
  sourceUpdatedAt: DateTime
  capturedAt: DateTime!
}

errors.name: OtherEventError
errors.description: A capture for another event: an event document keeps its identity
